hints: Keep a second array ways[] next to dist[]. ways[s] = 1.
On a strictly better distance, the old routes are all longer and no longer count: ways[v] = ways[u]. On an equal distance, these routes are extra shortest routes: ways[v] += ways[u].
It only works because u is finalised when you relax from it, so ways[u] is already complete. That is also why weights must be positive here.
title: Dijkstra: how many shortest paths?
